description: Read only targeted news editorial launch and ledger after guarded attempt

steps.name: diagnose-news-guardfix
steps.script:
$f='C:\TTiTTulares\ttittulares-mobile-trigger.log'
$l=@(Get-Content $f -Tail 350 | Where-Object { $_ -match 'tt-guardfix-1794481657530|NEW_CHAT_NOT_BLANK|CHAT LAUNCH LOG ERROR|LAUNCH CONFIRMED|LAUNCH FAILED|CHAT MESSAGE TIMEOUT' } | Select-Object -Last 24)
$d=Get-ChildItem 'C:\TTiTTulares\TT-Editorial-Rescue\sent' -Filter '*tt-guardfix-1794481657530*.json' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
$o=@{state='ok';lines=@($l|ForEach-Object{[string]$_|Select-Object -Last 1});ledger=if($d){(Get-Content $d.FullName -Raw).Substring(0,[Math]::Min(1800,(Get-Content $d.FullName -Raw).Length))}else{''}}
Write-Output ('TTRESULT:'+($o|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 5))
